title: PACS Group Announces Chief Legal Officer Transition
summary: SALT LAKE CITY, September 21, 2026--PACS Group, Inc. ("PACS" or the "Company") announced today that John Mitchell has retired, effective Sept. 18, 2026, from his position as Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary. Following his retirement, Mitchell will serve as a consultant to PACS to support an orderly leadership transition.

title: PACS Group Shares Rise 3.3% as Company Plans Florida Expansion and Completes More Eduro Acquisitions
PACS Group to Acquire Operations of 32 Facilities Across Florida and Closes on Additional Previously Announced Eduro Facilities
summary: SALT LAKE CITY, September 01, 2026--PACS Group, Inc. (NYSE: PACS) announced today that subsidiaries of the Company have entered into definitive agreements to acquire the operations of 32 skilled nursing facilities across Florida. The facilities will be leased from subsidiaries of one of our existing REIT landlords, Omega Healthcare Investors, Inc. (NYSE: OHI).
